title: App skeleton (CSS Grid)
instructions:
Goal:

We are creating an interface for a web application (e.g., a Dashboard). We need to split the screen into a left dark panel and right white content.

  • Apply the technology suitable for creating grids to .app-layout
  • Create exactly two columns.
  • The left column (sidebar) must have a fixed width 280px.
  • The right column must be dynamic and take up the entire rest of the screen (use the special Grid unit for this, not percentages!).

checks.message: CSS Grid is ideal for creating the page layout.
checks.studentHint: The application container uses a grid.

checks.message: The column split is incorrect. One should have pixels, the other a fractional unit of the free space.
checks.studentHint: Space distribution: 280px for the menu, the rest for the content.
